name: companio
description: Companio — platonic companion booking platform: API + website + admin (monorepo)

scripts.setup: npm run build:packages && npm run db:setup -w @companio/api
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @companio/api && npm run build -w @companio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
